page_title: RAY 1-1 SEV | Rayo Vallecano v Sevilla 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: de Tomas R. Lacking Match Fitness

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

90+1' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) replacing Adria Pedrosa.
90' A substitution has been made. Ruben Vargas is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Pablo Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.

84' A great job from two opposing players there. Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fired a shot nicely in on goal from distance towards the top left corner, while Orjan Nyland produced a wonderful piece of goalkeeping to parry the ball onto the post! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.
81' 1 - 1 Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Augusto Batalla with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
81' Rayo Vallecano fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
80' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
79' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
76' The game has come to an end for Djibril Sow. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
75' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Isaac Romero and he is replaced by Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla).
75' A pass from Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla and the move breaks down.
72' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:9.
70' A substitution has been made. Adrian Embarba goes off and Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
70' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Pedro Diaz will be replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
70' The referee signals a substitution. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Oscar Trejo.
69' Substitution. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) in, Jose Angel Carmona out.
67' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
65' The attendance for today's match is 11947.
64' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

61' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
59' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
58' The ball possession is 67:33.

55' 1 - 0 Alvaro Garcia looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the crossbar. The score is 1:0.
52' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
49' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
47' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) dribbles into the box, but Orjan Nyland is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

46' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
46' Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+4' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle and signals a foul after Saul Niguez (Sevilla) brought his opponent down. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The foul by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) was seen by Pablo Fuertes who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
42' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Augusto Batalla.
40' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
38' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

36' Kike Salas (Sevilla) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
36' Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Abdul Mumin is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano).
31' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
29' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Pablo Fuertes who sees an offensive foul.
26' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Inigo Perez is forced to make a change. Randy Nteka is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano).
24' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
21' A cross from a corner kick by Sevilla is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
19' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Orjan Nyland makes a great save.
17' Rayo Vallecano are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
15' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
13' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle and it's Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
11' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
8' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

7' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. It will be a corner kick for Sevilla.
7' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) launches a cross from the corner, but Augusto Batalla is alert to thwart the effort.
6' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
3' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
1' A snap shot by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Augusto Batalla produces a good save to thwart him.
1' The match has just started.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Pablo Fuertes is the one to supervise the game today.
